docTitle: Choosing Storage: DB Types & Key Technologies - SDE Prep Dojo
description: Key-value, document, wide-column, graph, time-series, search, blob and vector stores; deep cards for Postgres, MySQL, Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, S3 and ClickHouse; and a decision flowchart you can use in any system design interview.

Level 3 - Intermediate 45 min HLD concept

Choosing Storage: DB Types & Key Technologies

By the end you can look at any interview prompt, name the shape of its data, pick a database family and a real product in one sentence each, and defend the choice with numbers and the one failure mode you would watch.
